items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I would always do a number with him. ... we would do the bit together

ctx.x: Irv Cotler, and he had two violinists, Raderman, Mrs. Raderman, I can't think of their -- Sally Raderman and Lou Raderman. And he didn't have a bass with us, we would pick up a bass when we -- when I was with him, and myself. And I would always -- he's alway featuring me, and I would always do a number with him. I would take --
we would get the stool and we would do the bit together, and that was a thrill because I just loved playing for him, you know.
